note: Positive TestRFC2661EveryEmittedMessageOpensWithMessageType reads the first AVP of all ten body writers plus the HELLO; these are the eleven non-test sites that write a Message Type AVP (SCCRQ, SCCRP, SCCCN, StopCCN, ICRQ, ICRP, ICCN, OCRQ, OCRP, CDN, HELLO). Negative TestReactor_MalformedSCCRQCreatesNoTunnel: an SCCRQ with Host Name first is refused and creates no tunnel. Text duplicates RFC2661-4.4.1-2.
